name: Sobha Ltd
title: Sobha Ltd - 532784 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Sobha FY26 presales hit record INR8,136 cr (+30%) with net cash INR800 cr, but Q4 EBITDA of INR194 cr and margin recovery pushed to FY27 H2 on delayed occupancy certificates.
